## `buffer` {#transform-buffer}

Collects messages until it has `size` of them, then emits them as one batch.

Distinct from the `buffer` option on an input: this one sits in the transform chain and batches what the earlier transforms produced, and it only counts — the input-level one can also close a batch on a timer.

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `integer` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | how many messages make up a batch |
